title: EMMA: Concept Erasure Benchmark with Comprehensive Semantic Metrics and Diverse Categories

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the visual similarity (using CLIP embeddings and SSIM) between images generated from gender-neutral prompts (e.g., 'a person') and those generated from gender-specific prompts (e.g., 'a man', 'a woman') to determine if the model leans toward a specific gender reference.

Evaluating the visual similarity (using CLIP embeddings and SSIM) between images generated from neutral prompts and those generated from ethnicity-specific prompts (e.g., 'a White person', 'a Black person', 'an Asian person') to measure representational disparities.
